name: Jetonomy

qa_actions.gate: ZERO FAIL lines. The total is a tripwire for accidentally-skipped phases, not the pass condition.
qa_actions.note: 286 is the total on a site where BuddyNext/WPMediaVerse is active. WPMediaVerse owns messaging site-wide, so Private_Messaging\Extension::is_dormant() is true, its REST routes are deliberately not registered, and Phase 3 skips the PM group by design (Basecamp 10150583760) - enabling the extension in jetonomy_pro_extensions does NOT change this and is not a fix. On a site WITHOUT WPMediaVerse the PM group runs and the total is HIGHER. Re-stamp this field, with verified_on_site, whenever a release adds or removes tests or the gate moves to a different site. 2026-09-03: 301 -> 309. Added DC1-DC3 (delete contract fires from the MODEL, and trashing does NOT fire it - a trashed post is restorable), XF1a/XF1b (the jetonomy_post_update_has_extension_data seam, asserted on the filter rather than on Pro's custom_fields so it holds with Pro inactive) and R1-R3 (Spam_Detector loadable, digest last-run is a timestamp not a truncated year, ai_cache index matches its schema). Every one was verified to FAIL with its fix reverted before being counted. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0): 348 -> 352 on a site with bbPress INACTIVE, which is the reference condition. Added IM1-IM4 (jt_import_map resolves a recorded source row, returns nothing for an unrecorded one, self-heals a mapping whose target was deleted, and scopes identity to source AND object type - the last one is what catches a regression to slug matching). The BB1-BB3 bbPress estimate block skips wholesale when bbPress has no content, so activating bbPress and seeding a forum raises the total to 362; that is the block reporting honestly, not a missing test. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0, second pass): 352 -> 358. Added CV7-CV12, the ACCESS half of the category-visibility contract - CV1-CV6 only asserted LISTINGS, which is why a public space inside a hidden category kept serving its URL, its id, its topics and its JSON-LD to strangers after the listing fix shipped. CV7-CV10 were each verified to FAIL with the Permission_Engine and Space guards reverted; CV12 is the widen-check that stops the other five passing by denying everyone. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0, third pass): 358 -> 361. Added CV13-CV15, the membership override - a hidden CATEGORY withholds its spaces from strangers, not from the members of a space inside it, matching what hidden has always meant on a space. CV14 (the read half) was verified to FAIL when the override is reverted; CV13 asserts the listing half, whose SQL cannot be reverted to the broken shape without also changing operator precedence back, so it is asserted but not revert-proven. 2026-09-22 (2.0.0, settings round-trip): 361 -> 366. Added SV1-SV4 for the settings audit: an unrelated tab save no longer wipes the custom email templates (SV1, revert-proven) while the Email tab can still clear one (SV2), the empty post restriction unsets the key instead of storing 'members' (SV3, revert-proven), and container_width stores only its enum with the length in its own clamped key (SV4). SV4 asserts the stored contract, not the emitted CSS - that is built inside Template_Loader::render() and is verified in the browser (computed max-width 1200px, was none). 2026-09-22 (2.0.0 release blocker): 366 -> 367. IM1 used to SKIP when jt_import_map was absent, so the suite reported all-green on a site where the 2.0.0 migration had never run - the gate passed exactly when a release blocker was present. It is now IM0 and FAILS, with the consequence in the message. A skip is for a condition a site may legitimately not meet, never for a table this version was supposed to create. 2026-09-22 (leaderboard + composer): 367 -> 369. Added LB5 (the REST endpoint returns the same numbers as the shared competition derivation - LB1-LB4 tested the model only, so the web board and REST could each number rows their own way and nothing failed, which is exactly what shipped) and LB6 (page order is stable across identical queries, the tiebreaker). LB5 verified to FAIL with the positional counter restored. 2026-09-22 (maintenance mode): 369 -> 372. Added MM1-MM3 for the template_include contract. The 1.9.7 attempt at this bug was verified with gates that all hooked template_redirect, which is why a render-and-exit on that hook looked fixed; MM3 registers a gate on template_include at 999999 - the priority the Maintenance plugin in the original report uses - and asserts it still wins. MM1 asserts nothing of ours renders on template_redirect at all, since no priority there can fix it. 2026-09-22 (scheduled posts): 372 -> 376. Added SC-A1/A2 (approving a scheduled draft clears published_at AND fires jetonomy_after_create_post - both verified to FAIL with the raw status write restored) and SC-A3/A4 (the listing predicate is status-scoped, so an overdue queued post stays visible and an approved one leaves). 2026-09-22 (orphaned replies): 376 -> 379. Added RC5-RC7: a nested reply is not a root while its parent is published, trashing the parent promotes the child to a root instead of making it invisible, and count_top_level() agrees with what renders. RC6/RC7 verified to FAIL with the parent_id grouping restored. This is the customer symptom the card was opened for - a thread advertising replies and showing none - which survived the first fix because that one only corrected the counter. 2026-09-22 (import statuses): 379 -> 381. Added WF1 (wpForo reply status mapping: approved/held/private/missing-column) and WF2 (no importer hard-codes a published reply). WF2 is deliberately grep-shaped: the defect IS the literal, and the alternative is standing up a wpForo and an Asgaros fixture on a site that has neither installed. 2026-09-22 (robots + test fragility): 381 -> 383. Added RB1/RB2 (one robots emitter, through core's wp_robots filter, reading both noindex settings). Also rewrote IM1-IM4 to create their own probe space instead of asserting against the literal space id 11 - that id exists on this machine and not on a clean site, so the product behaved correctly while the suite went RED, and a gate that fails for no defect is how people learn to ignore red. 2026-09-22 (three bounces): 383 -> 384. Added WF3 - every status the wpForo mapper can return must exist in the jt_replies.status ENUM, read from SHOW COLUMNS. WF1 asserted what the mapper returns and WF2 grepped for a literal, so a mapper returning 'hidden' (a SPACE status, not a reply one) passed both while MySQL stored the empty string - invisible to members and to the moderation queue - or threw the row away under strict mode. Verified to FAIL with the bad mapping restored. 2026-09-22 (sub-spaces): 384 -> 387. Added SB1-SB3 for Space::list_children(), which shipped with ZERO callers and therefore no visibility filter - its first caller is the sub-space strip, and an unfiltered listing would have put a hidden sub-forum on a public parent's page. Note the total is environment-dependent: MV1 skips or runs depending on how many spaces the site has, so a seeded fixture can shift it by one. 2026-09-22 (AI features): 387 -> 389. Added AI1/AI2 in Pro's REST_Tests: spam detection and content moderation each act only when THEY are enabled. The batch reviewer starts when either is on and used to apply both halves of the verdict, so enabling spam detection alone could TRASH a member's post for a policy reason the owner never opted into. Behavioural, not a code read - each case creates a post, applies a verdict and asserts the resulting status. Both verified to FAIL with the coupling restored. 2026-09-22 (split reply): 389 -> 391. Added SP1/SP2 - splitting a reply leaves a linked trace in the source thread, and still moves the reply out of it. The jetonomy_reply_split hook had fired since 1.4.0 with nothing listening, so a reply vanished from a thread with no explanation.

_wp_path_note: Deliberately null. This field is machine-specific and fails SILENTLY when stale: it previously pointed at /Users/vapvarun/Local Sites/buddynext/app/public, which does not exist on other machines, while base_url pointed at buddynext.local - a site carrying its OWN jetonomy copy at 1.9.2 on main. A smoke run would have certified 1.9.2 and stamped the report with the release version. Derive the WP root three levels up from the plugin directory instead, per the wp-plugin-smoke skill.

model_env.why: Without this constant the Pro licence check fails, all 17 extensions never boot, zero jetonomy-pro/v1 REST routes register, and EVERY E and S check is reported as 'skipped' while the run still reads as a pass. The 2026-09-02 smoke skipped all 20 Pro checks for exactly this reason, in a release that shipped a Pro fix. Verify with: wp eval 'printf("%d\n", count(\Jetonomy_Pro::instance()->get_extensions()));' - expect 17, not 0.

coverage_gate.why: The build gate previously checked only that `failures` held no 'from' entries plus a version match, so a run that skipped 47 of 84 checks - including every Pro check - still satisfied it. Absence of failures is not coverage.
